title: Visual oracle E2E for Blur, Glow, and Bevel filters
description: Added filter oracle tests for Blur/Glow/Bevel in apps/desktop/e2e/visual-oracle.spec.ts (Tests 7b/7c/7d). All three pass locally. CI-skipped. SWF encoding for all three filters verified correct by byte-level inspection of published SWF. Key finding: bundled Ruffle 0.1.0 does not visually render the glow halo, so the glow test asserts the rect renders against the grey background (diffFromGrey > 60) rather than asserting blue glow pixels. Blur and Bevel use simple non-white-pixel counts.
